catalog: assets/dmzultra/form_parts/forms.json + every set table (sets.json order, then unlisted tables)
note: Generated; do not hand-edit. Form key is race/group/form, the same key DMZUltra FormParts.of builds (variant keys such as #slim are left out). Piece ids are FormParts ids; 'pieces' is forms.json's piece list, the ids every client can draw, and the Body Parts Shop list. 'designs' carries the per-form FormParts Design colors (own/trim/horn/light from the upstream a/b/c/g keys) so a dedicated server can send explicit colors in GuiModelSyncPacket without the client mod.
